title: Woman Gets Herself Arrested for Refusing to Wear Mask at Courthouse
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On January 14, 2022, Calvert County Sheriff’s deputies responded to the county courthouse for a disorderly subject in Prince Frederick, MD. A female showed up to protest against the mask mandate while refusing to wear a mask inside the building. Due to her behavior, she was asked to leave but she refused. Deputies arrived and they received an earful. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
